title: Cutting Edge Intensive Challenge
description: An advanced research-development programme for nurses and nursing researchers.

expanded.overview: The Cutting Edge Intensive Challenge is an advanced research-development programme designed for nurses and nursing researchers who want to take their skills to the next level.
topics: Connecting with Experienced Professionals and Researchers
expanded.testimonial: One participant described it as transformative because it combined research knowledge with practical skills and professional networking.

title: Cutting Edge Research in Nursing
description: A 6-week research mentorship programme designed to build nursing research capacity.

expanded.overview: This research mentorship programme is specifically designed to build nursing research capacity. Organized in collaboration with the Nigerian Universities Nursing Students' Association (NUNSA) National, it takes nursing students and young nurses beyond simply writing a school research project and helps them understand how research actually works.
expanded.testimonial: Research should help nurses become trailblazers, influence policy, and transform healthcare systems — rather than simply completing research as an academic requirement.

title: Evidence-Based Practice Implementation Training(1)
description: This program equip nurses with intense practical skills to improve patient care using proven research.

expanded.overview: This training is organized by GLLIA in collaboration with Jos University Teaching Hospital (JUTH). Its purpose is to equip nurses with practical skills for using research evidence and real-world strategies to improve patient care.
goals: Apply the latest evidence in patient care
Earn a recognized certificate of participation
expanded.highlight: Moving beyond learning evidence to actually implementing evidence in healthcare environments.
expanded.partner: In collaboration with Jos University Teaching Hospital
